Preserve the wide 16:9 framing, entire Forge UGC illustrated logo, blurred colorful Roblox city backdrop, dark navy beveled outer shell, header navigation, resource counters and settings icon. Design the body fresh for the specified screen. Every requested button, icon, input, tab and control must be completely visible, readable, aligned, and inside the screen.
